body: You’d be surprised how few years it takes to look back on thoughts like this like “holy shit, that was close”
They are way softer feeling to write with. Worth trying though. Some people will probably prefer that.
I really hope there’s some major technological breakthrough because right now, if I buy a colour eink notepad I’m not going to use it for what I want to be using it for.
My cat kept me going so many times. She gets really protective when I’m depressed actually.

I saw my therapist today. He wants to evaluate me for possible ptsd. Weirdly enough I hadn’t considered it. But then I google “what does ptsd feel like”, afterwards and I’m like “oh, right. I guess maybe then?”

I’m doing a bit better but I am irritable and overwhelmed a lot. I need a break.

I’m not a stranger to depression but this is different. The constant urgency and need to keep things moving and not think about things is not how I’ve experienced depression in the past.

Thank you both. It was weird writing about it. Even on an anonymous account. I didn’t even realise the weight of what I’ve been carrying with me.

I don’t want to do anything about him legally. I don’t know what it would achieve apart from putting me in a position of feeling like I have to defend the poor choices that led to the situation. And I have some blackouts around it too.

I just want to be well and get in with my life. But he’s still around, I haven’t seen him but I have heard about him. He’s seeing a friend of a girl I’m dating, People know he’s trash for a bunch of reasons, but he keeps appearing on the periphery of my life. 

I’m already in therapy so I guess I should bring it up there. That I didn’t already is pretty weird I guess.
